title.zh: 分子氢电荷交换Maxwellian速率系数

summary: Evaluate the saved H2 + H2+ charge-exchange Maxwellian rate-coefficient fit from paired plasma temperature and impact energy samples in eV.

identity.relation: molecular-H2 charge-exchange Maxwellian rate coefficient from a bivariate logarithmic fit
identity.direction: paired plasma temperature and impact energy in eV -> rate coefficient in m^3/s
identity.definition: Sequentially clip positive temperature and nonnegative impact energy to [0.1, 2.01e4] eV. With L_T=log(T), L_E=log(E), accumulate log_rate=sum_j=0..8 sum_i=0..8 a[i,j]*L_E^j*L_T^i using the saved energy-outer, temperature-inner addition order and the saved molecular 9x9 coefficient table. Return exp(log_rate)*1e-6 m^3/s. The output keeps the paired input shape.
identity.model: saved KN1DPy molecular-H2 nine-by-nine bivariate logarithmic rate fit; not a velocity-mesh Maxwellian integral
identity.geometry: none; paired scalar or array material samples
identity.coordinates: temperature and impact energy in eV, with no spatial or velocity axis inferred
identity.boundary: finite real numeric inputs of identical shape; temperature strictly positive, impact energy nonnegative; source endpoint clipping in both dimensions; finite positive represented output
assumptions: The molecular coefficient table and saved summation order are retained on finite real inputs for exact historical replay.

The atomic-H charge-exchange rate is a distinct physical system with another coefficient table. The molecular fit also does not call the molecular cross-section fit or maxwellian-relative-speed-rate-average; their equivalence is not established.
The saved operator document describes broadcast-compatible input shapes but the callable requires exact shape equality. The maintained contract follows the observed callable.

The saved implementation clips nonpositive temperature and negative energy despite its document's declared input domain, and accepts boolean and numeric-string coercions. The maintained callable rejects these inputs.

inputs.name: temperature_ev
inputs.description: Plasma temperature for the saved molecular Maxwellian rate fit.
inputs.shape: scalar or array; exactly the shape of energy_ev
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; values below 0.1 or above 2.01e4 eV are clipped to the respective endpoint.

inputs.name: energy_ev
inputs.description: Impact energy paired with each temperature sample.
inputs.shape: scalar or array; exactly the shape of temperature_ev
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; zero and positive values below 0.1 or above 2.01e4 eV are clipped to the respective endpoint.

outputs.name: rate_m3_s
outputs.description: H2 + H2+ charge-exchange Maxwellian rate coefficient evaluated by the molecular fit.
outputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive on accepted inputs; no physical reference accuracy is asserted.

preconditions: The caller accepts the saved endpoint-clipping convention and supplies physically paired temperatures and impact energies.
supported: Scalar and equal-shape array evaluation of the saved molecular-H2 charge-exchange rate fit on or clipped to its declared domain.
excluded: Atomic-H charge exchange, molecular elastic scattering, dissociation, CX collision-frequency assembly and explicit velocity-mesh averaging of a cross section.
External atomic-physics accuracy claims or physical correctness outside the saved fit's compared domain.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real numeric, non-finite or unequal-shape inputs, nonpositive temperature or negative energy. Boolean, complex and numeric-string coercions are rejected.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the derived rate is non-finite or nonpositive; no partial output is returned.

example.description: Evaluate the molecular fit and compare it with the distinct atomic fit.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import evaluate_hydrogen2_charge_exchange_rate, evaluate_atomic_hydrogen_charge_exchange_rate
t = np.array([0.1, 10.0, 20100.0])
e = np.array([0.2, 10.0, 20100.0])
r = evaluate_hydrogen2_charge_exchange_rate(t, e)
a = evaluate_atomic_hydrogen_charge_exchange_rate(t, e)
assert r.shape == (3,) and np.all(np.isfinite(r)) and np.all(r > 0.0)
assert not np.allclose(r, a, rtol=1e-12, atol=0.0)
example.expected: Three positive molecular rates, numerically distinct from the atomic-H fit on the same pairs.

scope: Fixed saved reference values and independent polyval2d reevaluation verify the molecular coefficient direction and fit on ordinary samples; the double-upper-endpoint corner is checked against the saved-order value.
Direct tests cover molecular-vs-atomic difference, clipping, scalar shape, invalid domain and non-real input rejection.
Five optional SHA-gated historical replays compare finite one- and two-dimensional carriers exactly and document three rejection differences.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the discrete molecular fit, clipping, sibling difference and failure contract on tested samples. SHA-gated saved replay establishes historical arithmetic agreement on compared grids only. No external atomic-physics oracle validates the fit; whole-source D1 qualification, expert approval and distribution licensing are absent.
known_limitations: The saved package records an external atomic-physics validation_oracle_gap; the fit is not independently validated as a physical rate model.
Out-of-fit-range values silently repeat endpoint rates rather than extrapolating or failing.
The fitted rate is not derived at runtime from the separate molecular cross-section asset or the mesh rate-average asset.
The saved bundle's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn, and public distribution licensing remains pending.
